lines.en: Stormrook is finally ours. We're in the belly of the beast - no turning back now!  Move our base of operations here - Stormrook will be our springboard to assault Rimorgue City.
lines.zh: 风鸦堡终于是我们的了。我们已经深入敌方腹地——现在可没有回头路了！ 把我们的大本营移到这里，风鸦堡将成为我们进攻里莫格城的跳板。

lines.en:
Brood of Kalytos the Red, the time is now!  Dive onto Stormrook and destroy the invaders!
Didn't learn the first time, Protagonist?  You'll pay a heavy price for your arrogance.
This is our last chance!!  We are the elite, the proudest sons of Veridia... today we defend our homeland!!  Knights of the 1st Army, push south and make Protagonist regret ever coming here!

War historians have always salivated at the idea of a decisive battle taking place here, at the Rimorgue River Valley.  But rarely would any army would be in a position to oppose whoever controls it.  Here we stand now, about to face the best of Casamir's army.  Our truest test begins now...  and to today's victor goes the fate of the world.
lines.zh: 战争史家总爱畅想如果里莫格河谷发生大决战会如何。 但很少有军队能深入到与此处守军一决高下的地步。 现在我们站在这里，即将面对卡萨米尔最精锐的部队。 我们最真实的考验现在开始…… 而整个世界的命运，也将由今天的胜者所主导。
lines.name: 莱桑德

lines.en: Stuck in a castle, just like before...  Casamir, just to hunt you down, I'll find a third chance at life if I die today...
lines.zh: 困兽之斗，一如从前…… 卡萨米尔，就为了干掉你，哪怕我今天死了，我也会第三次活过来的……

lines.en: Not this time.  Protagonist, show them the power of the Nephilim Army.
lines.zh: 大可不必。 Protagonist，向他们展示圣灵军团的力量吧。
lines.name: 莱桑德
